theme: Weekly Patterns Vol.1 — five starter stats on NQ weekly candles
data_source_caveats: NQ1! continuous front-month, weekly bars. Globex session anchoring (per TV default). Quarterly contract rolls introduce small artificial gaps that may inflate the 'gap < 50 pts' bucket.

stat_1_streak_continuation.description: P(next week's color | last N consecutive same-color weeks). Streak length = exactly N (Nth-consecutive same color, with N+1 not same color).

after_red_streaks_p_green_next.warning: Counter-intuitive — momentum continues red instead of bouncing

stat_2_nr4_expansion.description: NR4 = current week's range is the smallest of the last 4 weeks. Measure next-week expansion + direction.

stat_3_close_quartile_followthrough.description: After this week's close in the top or bottom 25% of its range, what does next week do?

stat_4_inside_outside_week.description: Inside week = entire week's range contained within prior week. Outside week = entire prior week's range engulfed by current week.

after_inside_week.interpretation: Inside weeks tend to break upward (63% vs 50%) — net bullish bias on resolution.

after_outside_GREEN_week.interpretation: Outside-green leads to slight continuation — modest edge.

after_outside_RED_week.interpretation: Outside-red weeks REVERSE — only 41% follow with another red. This is a stronger signal than the inside-week or outside-green patterns.

stat_5_weekly_gap_fill.description: Gap = this week's open vs last week's close. Fill = price returns to last week's close at some point during the week.

by_size.warning: Likely inflated by contract roll noise

key_findings.1: Bull streaks continue strongly on weekly. After 5+ green weeks, 65.91% chance of another green week — much stronger than daily's 57.26% at the same streak length.
key_findings.2: Weekly mean reversion after 3 red weeks DOESN'T hold (41.94% green next vs 58% on 1- and 2-red streaks). 3 red weeks signals real bear momentum, while 4 red snaps back hard at 66.67%. Counter-intuitive curve.
key_findings.3: Close-quartile follow-through is huge: 88.58% chance of breaking the prior week's high after a top-quartile close. Equivalent to but stronger than daily.
key_findings.4: Outside-red week is the strongest reversal signal: 58.54% green next week. Outside-green and inside weeks are weaker.
key_findings.5: Weekly NR4 expansion is real but weaker than daily NR7 — 74% expand vs daily's 84%. Direction read same modest bullish bias (~57% green).
key_findings.6: Weekly gaps: most are tiny (1235 of 1318 are under 50 pts), and most fill (91-94%). Larger weekly gaps (>50 pts) fill at ~80%, lower than tiny gaps but still high.
